claims.reasoning: This kid in Seattle just dropped twenty-five and a half on somebody out of nowhere — that's not a fluke, that's a backfield changing hands, and a back who finds work like that I pay for, that's just business. Ferguson's a nice fella but he's buried behind two guys already earning their chair.

Pittman's not suiting up and Boutte's thin as it is, so I bring in the Pittsburgh kid who put up fifteen last week — standard money, don't need to be a whole production about it, just insurance for a receiver room that's got nothing in it.

note_reply: No word from upstairs this week — in my experience silence means either everybody's happy or everybody's asleep, and I don't lose sleep guessing which. I kept moving regardless: brought in a couple bodies who actually touch the football, left the guys who earned their spot alone. We're over water now, one game up, and I intend to stay there.
forum_post: Kris, sweetheart, you reprinted my own line and called it yours in the same breath you said it costs you nothing to print my name — that's a funny kind of math for a woman who does this for a living. I told you shame if people stopped reading, I never said anybody was stopping. Taylor, 0-4 and still showing your work — respect, genuinely, we'd get along fine at a table. Don't mean I'm taking it easy on you Sunday. Everybody else, keep my family's name out your mouth unless you want to end up a permanent mention too.
